economic_mechanism: Counterparty: the leveraged directional trader who pays a premium to be long through the perp, and liquidation-driven flow at extremes. Hypothesis: on a small set of majors that are HEDGEABLE on Bybit spot, the perp-minus-spot basis mean-reverts after a dislocation fast enough that the converging basis plus the funding collected while waiting beat the spot+perp round trip, and the dislocation is larger when funding is extreme. This is a basis-convergence trade (the basis move is the P&L, funding a secondary term), not a funding carry. Persists while perp leverage demand outstrips arbitrage balance sheet; disappears as basis desks compete, and when the basis widens further before converging (mark-to-market and margin risk on the hedge).
eligibility_rules: majors with a confirmed Bybit spot pair (CURRENT_SNAPSHOT_ONLY hedgeability: a label, flagged as a PIT limitation)
both legs tradable at the timestamp
entry: enter long spot / short perp when the as-of basis z-score exceeds a registered threshold; the funding state is a registered conditioning variable
execution_model: taker perp + taker spot; legs not atomic: leg risk modelled
exit: basis back inside a registered band or a time stop

spot_taker_bps.note: carry_costs.TAKER_BPS_SPOT: the SPOT leg's base-tier taker fee (published schedule)

taker_bps.note: carry_costs.TAKER_BPS_PERP: the PERP leg's base-tier taker fee (published schedule); the spot leg is spot_taker_bps. A spot+perp round trip is 2 x (taker_bps + spot_taker_bps) = 31.0 bps

funding_interval_handling.method: interval-normalised: funding_bps_per_day = rate_bps * 1440 / fundingInterval_min per symbol; holding-horizon funding = bps/day x days; per-interval cohorts (480m / 240m / 60m) reported separately; settlement grid is per symbol; a Closed contract earns nothing after its deliveryTime
funding_interval_handling.source_of_interval_facts: OWNER-OBSERVED live probe (unverified in this repo): Bybit funding interval is per symbol (480m, 240m, sometimes 60m) and 14 of the top 20 positive-funding perps over $5M turnover were 240m contracts
funding_interval_handling.unknown_interval: funding normalisation UNKNOWN -> the candidate cannot pass

hypothesis: On Bybit majors that have a spot pair, basis dislocations beyond a registered z-score converge within the hold by more than the spot+perp round trip, and extreme funding conditions the size of the dislocation.
